title: Boston University WordPress REST API schemas
description: Schemas for the Boston University-operated WordPress REST API at https://www.bu.edu/wp-json. The error envelope and the page summary were captured verbatim from live anonymous responses on 2026-08-30. Boston University publishes no response schemas for these routes, so nothing beyond what was observed is described here.

x-provenance.source: live responses from https://www.bu.edu/wp-json/ (wp/v2/pages, bu-slideshow/v1/shows) captured 2026-08-30

examples: Sorry, you are not allowed to do that.

PageSummary.title: WordPress page summary
PageSummary.description: Field set observed from GET /wp/v2/pages?per_page=1&_fields=id,slug,link,type,status,date_gmt,title on 2026-08-30. This is a projection requested with _fields, not the full page object.
